Annotation Interface CrdbRetry

@Documented @Retention(RUNTIME) @Target(METHOD) public @interface CrdbRetry
Retries the annotated method on CockroachDB serialization anomalies (SQLSTATE 40001 / 40P01) using adaptive exponential backoff.

Unlike Transactional, this annotation does not open a transaction; it simply re-invokes the method body. Combine with Transactional for transactional retry, or use standalone around an already-transactional unit.
